claims.statement: H_t converges locally uniformly to Xi; the stated compact inequality excludes zeros; local multiplicity persists; near a simple real Xi zero the unique nearby H_t zero is real. The standard all-d RH escape equivalence is reproved only as scope.
claims.parameter_scope: Real t tends to 1; every fixed zero-free compact K; all-d equivalence for fixed d>0.
limitations: No simplicity assumption at multiple Xi zeros.
Compact persistence is not an endpoint expanding-region estimate.

claims.statement: A fixed original odd-phase branch in Re w>a satisfies dw/dlambda=-1/ell prime, decreasing Im z and speed<16/5. If nonempty its maximal exterior interval is (-infinity,beta), beta finite, and Re w tends to a at exit.
claims.parameter_scope: Real lambda on the maximal connected branch interval; a=2pi e^3.
limitations: No continuation or unchanged labeling to t=1 through the boundary.
Finite exit is not collision on the real axis.

claims.statement: For every fixed d>1/2, R_d(t)=4lambda/pi+O_d(log lambda), with exclusion of all lower-radius roots at every height and a true simple correctly phased root within the upper bound.
claims.parameter_scope: Each fixed real d>1/2; lambda=log(t/(1-t)) tends to positive infinity.
limitations: No uniformity as d decreases to 1/2.
This is an author proof, not an independent PASS.

claims.statement: For every fixed d>1/2, R_d(t)=4lambda/pi+(2d+7)log(lambda)/pi+O_d(1). The all-height lower bound and actual-root upper bound give the complete radial minimum.
claims.parameter_scope: Each fixed real d>1/2; lambda tends to positive infinity.
limitations: The bounded remainder is not asserted to converge.

claims.statement: Choose at each parameter a first-quadrant radial minimizer, breaking ties by least real part. Its height is d+O_d(1/log lambda), its original phase q=(2n+1)pi is asymptotic to 2lambda log(lambda)/pi, and n is asymptotic to lambda log(lambda)/pi^2.
claims.parameter_scope: Each fixed d>1/2; sufficiently large real lambda; selected minimizer at each parameter.
limitations: Selection may switch and need not be continuous.
Phase is not global radial rank or an old sufficient N(t).

claims.statement: At the explicitly prescribed x=T(lambda)+C and unique scalar modulus-balance height, the original normalized function at w=w_lambda+v/ell prime(w_lambda) equals 1+eta_lambda exp(v)+O_d,K((log lambda)^(-2)) locally uniformly. Along subsequences eta_lambda tends to eta, giving limit 1+eta exp(v) and local simple-zero persistence.
claims.parameter_scope: Each fixed d>1/2; compact complex v-sets; large real lambda, with subsequences for a fixed phase limit.
limitations: Residual phase is retained; no universal phase limit is asserted.
Generic analytic linearization with family-specific basepoint and bounds, not a new theta universality theorem.
Local profile points are only claimed in the Euler domain; not all are above d.
No critical-strip endpoint theorem for d<=1/2 and no new RH conclusion.
No Xi-zero simplicity, global trajectory classification or radial-order assumption.
No uniform bound on the old exceptional multiset as t approaches 1.
No numerical root scan or numerical certification.
No independent audit, formal proof verification or world-novelty determination.
No repair, replacement or subsequent research stage after this first freeze.

prior_art.scope: Five short public queries; primary formula checks and bounded Hotta–Wang, Lagarias–Montague and Sjöstrand comparisons. Known methods distinguished from exact theorem coverage.
